fields.label: Chunk Summary Model
fields.help: Model used for chunk-level summaries. Format: 'model_name' or 'backend:model_name'.

fields.label: Testing Mode
fields.help: Leave empty (None) to run the full pipeline, or a number to limit processing to N chunks for faster testing. The full chunk file is always preserved.

fields.label: Max Workers
fields.help: Concurrent LLM requests for chunk summaries. 1 = serial. HF TGI endpoints handle 4-8 well.

fields.label: Resume Summaries
fields.help: Skip chunks that already have a non-empty chunk_summary, so an interrupted run can resume without re-paying for completed summaries.

fields.label: Flush Every N
fields.help: Persist progress to a_chunks.json after every N summarized chunks, so a crash loses at most N summaries.

fields.label: Enable Chunk Summary
fields.help: Master toggle for chunk-level summary generation. Disable during testing to skip the LLM summary step.

fields.label: Chunk Summary Size (tokens)
fields.help: Maximum token count for each chunk summary.

fields.label: Chunk Summary Prompt
fields.help: Prompt template sent to the LLM for chunk summaries. Use {heading_context} and {size} as placeholders.

fields.label: Chunk Summary Temperature
fields.help: LLM temperature for chunk summaries. Lower values produce more deterministic output.

fields.label: Skip Chunk Threshold
fields.help: Chunks with fewer tokens than this are not summarized at all.

fields.label: Pad Chunk Threshold
fields.help: Chunks below this token count get extra context (heading path, summaries) appended to their content.

fields.label: Add Concat Header Path
fields.help: For small chunks, prepend the concatenated heading path to provide document-structure context.

fields.label: Add Chunk Summary
fields.help: For small chunks, append the chunk's own summary to its content.

fields.label: Add Page Summary
fields.help: For small chunks, append the parent page summary to the chunk content.

fields.label: Enable File Summary
fields.help: Generate a summary for each file / top-level heading. Disable to avoid content that competes with granular chunks.

fields.label: File Summary Model
fields.help: Model name for file-level summaries (e.g. 'openai:gpt-5-mini' or a local model identifier).

fields.label: File Summary Size (tokens)
fields.help: Maximum token count for file-level summaries.

fields.label: File Summary Prompt
fields.help: Prompt used for file-level summaries. Auto-generated from FILE_SUMMARY_SIZE.

fields.label: File Summary Temperature
fields.help: LLM temperature for file-level summaries.

fields.label: Enable Summary of Summaries
fields.help: Generate a roll-up summary when a heading has multiple child summaries.

fields.label: Child Count Threshold
fields.help: Minimum number of sibling summaries required before a summary-of-summaries is generated.

fields.label: Summary-Summary Model
fields.help: Model name for summary-of-summaries generation.

fields.label: Summary-Summary Size (tokens)
fields.help: Maximum token count for summary-of-summaries.

fields.label: Summary-Summary Prompt
fields.help: Prompt for summary-of-summaries. Auto-generated from SUMMARY_SUMMARY_SIZE.

fields.label: Summary-Summary Temperature
fields.help: LLM temperature for summary-of-summaries.

fields.label: Enable Code Summary
fields.help: Generate summaries for standalone code chunks. Currently unused in the pipeline.

fields.label: Code Summary Model
fields.help: Model name for code-chunk summaries.

fields.label: Code Summary Size (tokens)
fields.help: Maximum token count for code summaries.

fields.label: Code Summary Prompt
fields.help: Prompt for code summaries. Auto-generated from CODE_SUMMARY_SIZE.

fields.label: Code Summary Temperature
fields.help: LLM temperature for code summaries. Lower values (0.1–0.3) suit deterministic code descriptions.
